name: Client final cleanup red-team End-to-End closure
objective: Prove the integrated client slice clean, adversarially safe and fully verified on exact final candidate before closure.
truthOwner: Cross-owner verification; no new business truth owner

tasks.currentProblem: Functional fixes can leave versionless wrappers retired aliases duplicate adapters or stale generated artifacts.
tasks.requiredChange: Census changed slice, prove dead residue, delete it and converge contracts/imports/config on canonical owners.
tasks.targetState: No known dead duplicate retired or workaround path bypasses repaired invariants.
tasks.action: Run reference/contract census and cleanup guards, deleting only proven residue.
mustNotChange: No unrelated payout HR fleet admin work
tasks.rollback: Restore only a path proven required by a supported client, then redesign without parallel truth.

tasks.objective: Run adversarial cross-unit red-team and repair every in-scope finding.
tasks.currentProblem: Unit-local green checks do not prove replay race offline cross-actor cross-surface provider interactions.
tasks.requiredChange: Attack wrong actor/role/surface, stale version, replay, concurrency, timeout, unknown result, offline/restart, stale cache/push, deep-link/location/proof privacy and transition races.
tasks.targetState: No known adversarial case creates unauthorized access duplicate effect false final state privacy leak or split truth.
tasks.action: Execute matrix and reopen/fix owning U001-U006 until clean.
tasks.rollback: Never restore a red-team defect; reopen owner unit.
tasks.commitBoundary: Root-cause commits remain attributed to owner units.

tasks.objective: Resolve client-relevant verification blockers and prove exact-candidate closure.
tasks.currentProblem: Node setup has unidentified OpenAPI circular reference and broad WLT suite has unrelated payout compile failures.
tasks.requiredChange: Isolate OpenAPI context; repair only if client-consumed, otherwise retain external blocker. Run strict validator, contracts, full repo checks, Identity/DSH/WLT runtime/DB, native/device/visual, security/finance and exact-SHA CI.
tasks.targetState: Exact final candidate is reproducibly verified with all applicable client gates green.
tasks.action: Repin after last write, execute gates, inspect artifacts and update RESULTS/CLOSURE only with complete evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm install succeeds or blocker stays OPEN
tasks.rollback: A failed final gate reopens its owner unit; evidence is never rolled back to hide failure.
tasks.commitBoundary: Final bookkeeping only after all implementation writes.
